entry.title: Warmer, Drier Weather Starts the Week in Southern Oregon
entry.summary: Southern Oregon will start June warmer and drier, with Roseburg highs near 84 Monday and 87 Tuesday before a weak front brings cooler, seasonal weather Wednesday. Rain chances remain low and mostly limited to the coast and Cascades.
